stanzas.english_translation: Avt’handil said: "Ha, P’hridon! friends cannot complain of thee; thou hast hope in thy lion-like arms, wounds hurt not thee; thou counsellest hard counsel to make foes lament; but hearest thou not how very near the garrison shouts!
stanzas.expert_explanation_en: Chapter 56 ('Counsel of Avtandil', Stanza 1397; Wardrop Stanza 1373): Part of the narrative sequence in which avtandil objects that clanking armor would alert the guards on a rope, and proposes instead to enter the fortress alone disguised as a merchant with weapons concealed on a mule, then cut down the gate-guards from within.

stanzas.georgian_raw_text:
“რა გახვიოდე, გუშაგთა ესმას აბჯრისა ჩხერება,
გიგრძნობენ, თოკსა მოჰკვეთენ, ამისი ხამს დაჯერება;
წაგიხდეს ცუდად ყველაი, დაგრჩეს ცუდიღა ფერება,
და ეგე თათბირი არ ვარგა, სხვაებრ ვქმნათ თავის ტერება.
stanzas.english_translation: "When thou goest over, the garrison will hear the clatter of thine armour, they will perceive thee, they will cut the cord, of this thou must be assured. Everything will turn out ill for thee; only the vain attempt will remain to thee. That counsel is of no value; let us help ourselves in some other way.
stanzas.expert_explanation_en: Chapter 56 ('Counsel of Avtandil', Stanza 1398; Wardrop Stanza 1374): Part of the narrative sequence in which avtandil objects that clanking armor would alert the guards on a rope, and proposes instead to enter the fortress alone disguised as a merchant with weapons concealed on a mule, then cut down the gate-guards from within.

stanzas.georgian_raw_text:
“სჯობს, დადეგით დამალულნი თქვენ ადგილსა იდუმალსა,
ისი კაცნი არ იჭირვენ მგზავრსა, ქალაქს შემავალსა,
სავაჭროდა მოვეკაზმი, საქმესა ვიქმ მე მუხთალსა,
და ერთსა ჯორსა გარდავჰკიდებ მუზარადსა, ჯაჭვსა, ხრმალსა.
stanzas.english_translation: "This is better: you stay hidden in ambush. These men will not lay hands on a traveller coming into the town. I will dress myself as a merchant, I will do a treacherous deed; I will load a mule with helmet, hauberk and sword.
stanzas.expert_explanation_en: Chapter 56 ('Counsel of Avtandil', Stanza 1399; Wardrop Stanza 1375): Part of the narrative sequence in which avtandil objects that clanking armor would alert the guards on a rope, and proposes instead to enter the fortress alone disguised as a merchant with weapons concealed on a mule, then cut down the gate-guards from within.

stanzas.georgian_raw_text:
“სამთავე შესვლა არ ვარგა, თუ გვიგრძნან, არს სათუები;
მე მარტო შევალ ვაჭრულად და კარგად შევეტყუები,
მალვით ჩავიცვამ აბჯარსა, გავჩნდები, გავეცრუები,
და ღმერთმან ქმნას, უხვად ვადინო შიგნით სისხლისა რუები.
stanzas.english_translation: "It is of no use for the three of us to go in, there is risk that they would perceive it; I shall go alone as a merchant, and well shall I win in unnoticed; secretly shall [paragraph continues] I don mine armour, I shall appear, I shall deceive them. God grant that I may make channels of blood to flow generously in there!
stanzas.expert_explanation_en: Chapter 56 ('Counsel of Avtandil', Stanza 1400; Wardrop Stanza 1376): Part of the narrative sequence in which avtandil objects that clanking armor would alert the guards on a rope, and proposes instead to enter the fortress alone disguised as a merchant with weapons concealed on a mule, then cut down the gate-guards from within.

stanzas.georgian_raw_text:
“შიგნითა მცველთა მოვიცლი მე უნახავად ჭირისად,
თქვენ გარეთ კართა ეცემით, ყოველნი, მსგავსად გმირისად;
კლიტეთა დავლეწ, გავახვამ, დამიდგამს ვერ ქვიტკირი სად,
და თუ რა სხვა სჯობდეს, თქვენ ბრძანეთ, ვარ მრჩევლად ამა პირისად”.
stanzas.english_translation: "Without any difficulty I shall remove the guards inside; you strike outside the gate, all like heroes; I shall shatter the locks, I shall open, you will see the opening of the gate. If aught else would be better, say so; I am for a plan of this sort."
stanzas.expert_explanation_en: Chapter 56 ('Counsel of Avtandil', Stanza 1401; Wardrop Stanza 1377): Part of the narrative sequence in which avtandil objects that clanking armor would alert the guards on a rope, and proposes instead to enter the fortress alone disguised as a merchant with weapons concealed on a mule, then cut down the gate-guards from within.
